item.title: The Football Decline
item.description:
The Football Decline

Each time I discuss the modern football situation and why it feels so different from the golden era, I used to think it was just nostalgia. But there is a real shift in the game and industry, and many fans are starting to witness it.

In this article I will tackle that phenomenon: what makes football less attractive than before, and what are the root causes.

A Different Game Today

Since I was born after the 90s, I cannot claim to have lived through the old era, but the contrast is clear.

item.title: Why i don't watch football anymore
item.description:
Why i don’t watch football anymore

Don’t get me wrong i’ve been a football fan since I was 6 years old. I started by watching matches from our local league in morocco as well as games of our national team. I was obsessed with the sport: team histories, player’s names, and famous figures in the league.

As I got older, I began following international leagues such as la liga in spain and the Premier league in UK, along with major international competitions like the world cup and the African Cup.
